answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. A copper of per-task receipts records who did what, and the trellis of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. Reaching the sable of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, capped per identity per epoch, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
